# AAA Marcel projections (amendment 15; generated by `python -m src.marcel`)

Marcel adapted to AAA: last three AAA seasons (hitters 5/4/3, pitchers 3/2/1), regressed by 1,200 PA / 600 BF of league-average play, age factor; pitchers ranked by projected K% - BB%, hitters by projected wOBA.
